The six retired Grid and Table records (`table-covid`, `table-cell-editing`, `table-nested-record-fields`, `table-performance`, `table-store`, `json-grid-container`) leave the portal examples catalog: `examples.json` drops them (78 to 72 records, 21 to 15 in the family), each folder's `neo-config.json` now opts out with `"seo": false`, `seo.json` is regenerated without their routes, and both the unit and the e2e catalog specs recount the family. The example apps themselves stay in place; `grid-locked-columns` is untouched (#21167 owns it).

Evidence: the diff removes 104 lines from `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json` and nothing else in that file; unit suite `test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/view/examples` passes 35/35 and `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/docs/seo` 54/54; the browser-level `test/playwright/e2e/portal/ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs` passes 10/10 against real Chrome; `node buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs` reports `SEO verification passed: seo.json routes=334, lastmod=334, noindex=11, sitemap-core urls=321, core releases=2`.

Thanks, the scope reads right. On your open question: yes, please strip the six capture recipes here. CI's `unit` job fails without that:
